[[File:Dharus_GG9.jpg|thumb|right|Dharus with his ceremonial braid]]
A '''ceremonial braid''' was a style of tying one person's [[Hair/Legends|hair]], as defined by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dharus]] to describe his own hairstyle. Dharus tied his long brown hair in a twin braid that went before and after his neck.
